title: objectql/cli: a packages[] stack's own top-level residual items are judged by the namespace co-owner rule too (ADR-0150 child N follow-up)
body:
epic:#31527#1 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmP7o3uDTti21wLTfPf

Filing gate: ④ coordination node: a follow-up of child N (#31670, PR #31717) of the epic #31527, from that PR's contract review (record 6728707576, finding N3). ⛔ Not a claim.
Ruling-ref: ADR-0150 D2 accepted (record 6724570466): packages that share a namespace keep each behavioural `(type, name)` unique across it, so a qualified address names exactly one item. Division of labour A (6723571682).
Business reason: inherited from the parent #31527. A qualified address `/<namespace>/<name>` must name one item. Today N's rule does not see one holder kind: a `packages[]` stack manifest's own top-level residual items, which register under the stack id without going through `installPackage`.
Reader: the next `domain:server` seat (preferably the one holding N, K and G1, since this is the same `registry.ts` region). The epic seat reviews the PR against the red lines.
Dedupe (open AND closed): `namespace co-owner residual stack` (none on point beyond #31670 itself).
class: d · type: Feature
Grade: p1, inherited from the parent.
Blocked-by: #31670

## 维护者速读

N 的「同一命名空间里名字不能重复」规则漏了一种情况：多包栈清单自己顶层的残余条目，不走安装门，所以安装门和 os validate 都没判它们。这张卡补上，同一个谓词。

## What to build

Run N's one predicate (`namespace-co-owner-names.ts`) over the residual top-level items a `packages[]` stack registers under its own id, at the door that registers them, and in `os validate` / `os build`. Use the same message and code (`NAMESPACE_CONFLICT`, 422). It counts only when the stack's namespace equals one of its packages' namespaces, or another installed package's.

## Surface

- Expected file surface: objectql `registry.ts` (the residual registration path) and `namespace-co-owner-names.ts`; cli `validate.ts` / `compile.ts`, and the cli copy of the predicate.
- Clause-②: no.
- Narrowing: yes, the same rule as N, for one more holder kind (first-party count measured in the PR).

## Acceptance — the epic's three red lines

- **Resolution never loosens.**
- **Ambiguity is reported, never guessed.** The refusal names every holder.
- **Independently releasable.** Readings (a)–(d) as in every child. The narrowing is declared with its count.

Parent: #31527.
